skills.description: This skill should be used when the user uploads a .drawio BPM/process flowchart and asks to generate a process-node description table (with RACI) and a process-indicator table. It parses the swimlanes, nodes, and annotations from the flowchart and outputs strictly formatted Markdown tables.
skills.description_zh: 此技能可以输出泳道图的流程节点说明和流程考核指标。你需要提供：流程图截图或 .drawio 格式的 BPM流程图/泳道图（ .drawio 格式为佳）。技能会输出：1）流程节点表，包括：流程编号、流程步骤、流程步骤描述、业务规则、输入和输出；2）3-5个流程考核指标。
skills.name: 泳道图节点说明及流程指标生成
